claims.text: AARO sponsored an invite-only UAP research workshop in the Washington DC area in early August 2025, officially hosted by Associated Universities, Inc., with roughly 40 government, academic and independent researchers; Pentagon spokesperson Sue Gough said AARO recognises 'input from the scientific and academic community is critical to its work.'
